notes: Background music made with the ElevenLabs Music API. id -> {prompt, seconds}. Played by music(id) in core.js; tracks loop with a crossfade, so avoid big endings on looping tracks. Run: node --env-file=.env tools/make-music.mjs
style: 8-bit chiptune, NES / Game Boy style square and triangle waves, kids video game, instrumental, no vocals

title.prompt: Cheerful catchy title-screen theme, bouncy melody, medium tempo, invites you to press start, seamless loop, no ending

drive.prompt: Upbeat bouncy driving music for a co-op smash-everything game, playful bassline, steady snappy drums, happy and energetic but not frantic, seamless loop, no intro and no ending

boss.prompt: Goofy epic boss battle music, fast and dramatic but silly and fun, never scary, driving arpeggios and big drums, seamless loop, no ending

victory.prompt: Triumphant victory fanfare, bright and happy, ends on a big final chord
